description: A modern, multilingual YouTube Music client for Android with offline support. N-Zik is your ultimate, open-source, multilingual YouTube Music client for Android! 🎵🚀 A multilingual fork of Kreate, focused on performance, UI/UX polish, bug fixes, and new features with long-term support. Development & Stability: N-Zik started as a side project for myself and friends. It may not be as stable as Kreate yet — check out Metrolist, VIVI Music, or RiPlay for something more mature. Transparent AI Usage: I use generative AI to assist with code (via the BMAD Method), but everything is reviewed and tested before shipping. Not your thing? No hard feelings — plenty of great alternatives exist. Whether you're a casual listener or a hardcore audiophile, N-Zik gives you absolute control over your music, without compromising your privacy. ✨ WHY CHOOSE N-ZIK? No ads, full background playback, offline caching, and a fully customizable interface — free, always. 🎨 Customizable UI - Jetpack Compose UI with a Classic ViMusic mode toggle 🌓 - Custom themes: True AMOLED, Deep Dark, Crisp Light + tinted accents - 3D Carousel Player 🎠 and customizable home screen widgets 🪟 - Detailed artist profiles, News Feed, and experimental widgets 🧪 🎵 Audio Experience - Premium quality audio via YouTube Music Premium (Web Remix client) 🔊 - Advanced synced lyrics with editing & real-time translation 🎤 - Real-time audio visualizer 🎇 and pro controls: speed, pitch, normalization, crossfade, volume boost 🎚️ 💾 Offline, Metadata & Privacy - Smart offline caching & downloads for tracks and playlists 📡 - FFmpeg-powered export with full embedded metadata 📤 (64-bit builds only) - In-app metadata editor (AAC/Opus, cover art) ✏️ - 100% local listening stats & history 📊 - Auto-backup with custom intervals & retention ⚙️ 🔗 Integrations - YouTube sign-in for recommendations & audio/video switching 📺 - Discord Rich Presence 🎮 - Playlist import/export: RiPlay, Spotify (Exportify), YouTube Music, N-Zik 🔄 📱 Play Anywhere: Android Auto, Automotive, TV, and Tablets 🚗📺 🛠️ Power User Features - Text & voice search 🎙️ - OTA updates from GitHub ⬇️ - Sleep timer & background playback 💤 🛡️ N-Zik is 100% open-source (FOSS). Key permissions: INTERNET (streaming/lyrics/updates), RECORD_AUDIO (visualizer only, opt-in, never listens), STORAGE (exports/backups), FOREGROUND_SERVICE/NOTIFICATIONS (playback), REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES (OTA), BLUETOOTH (wireless audio), WAKE_LOCK (keep playback alive). 📦 Available Builds - Full & Beta: Complete build with all components (64-bit only) - Full32 & Beta32: Complete build without FFmpeg (32-bit & 64-bit) - Minified: Lightweight build, recommended for low-end devices (64-bit only) - Minified32: Lightweight build without FFmpeg (32-bit & 64-bit) - FOSS: Full build without auto-updater, for F-Droid (64-bit only) - Dev & Dev32: Development builds from latest commits, testing only Standard builds are 64-bit only because they bundle FFmpeg; "32" builds drop FFmpeg to work on both architectures. Only the FOSS build is on F-Droid. Starting January 2027 (why the date changed), Google will require identity verification for all Android developers, even outside Google Play. As a Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) project, N-Zik and its developer oppose this requirement due to its impact on developer privacy, independent distribution, and software freedom. 📖 Learn more · ✍️ Sign the petition
